def test_install_cmd_installs_only_packages_and_compilers():
    """The bootstrap script is the promise: no Ollama, no Docker, no model, no client."""
    script = (ROOT / "install.cmd").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    flat = " ".join(script.split())
    # what it must do
    assert 'set "PY=python"' in flat and 'set "PY=py -3.12"' in flat
    assert 'sys.version_info[:2] != (3,12)' in flat, "it must detect Python 3.12"
    assert "Python.Python.3.12" in flat, "a missing 3.12 is installed"
    assert "pip install --user -q --disable-pip-version-check pefile capstone" in flat
    assert "roc.py install" in flat, "the compiler bundles come from roc install"
    assert "roc.py link install" in flat, "roconstruct:// must be registered"
    assert "roc.py doctor" in flat
    # nothing launches by itself: the user starts the worker when they want to
    assert "roc.py launch" in flat, "the bootstrap must say how to start the worker"
    assert "start \"\" \"https" not in flat, "the installer must not open the browser on its own"
    assert "roc.py setup" not in flat, "the installer must not start the setup questions itself"
    # what it must never do
    for forbidden in ("Ollama.Ollama", "Docker.DockerDesktop", "ollama pull", "docker pull",
                      "client-fetch", "Docker.DockerDesktop.iso"):
        assert forbidden not in flat, "install.cmd must not install %s" % forbidden


def test_verified_client_is_never_downloaded_again():
    """A client already on disk and matching its hash is left alone."""
    from roc import clients, link
    entry = {"exe": "Roblox.exe", "sha256": "abc"}
    with patch("roc.clients.load", return_value={"2008-06": entry}), \
         patch("roc.clients.status", return_value="ok"), \
         patch("roc.clients.fetch", side_effect=AssertionError("re-downloaded")) as fetch:
        link.wait_for_exe("2008-06", log=lambda *a: None)
    assert not fetch.called, "a verified client must not be fetched again"
    # ... but a missing or mismatched one is fetched, because byte matching needs it
    for status in ("missing", "hash mismatch"):
        with patch("roc.clients.load", return_value={"2008-06": entry}), \
             patch("roc.clients.status", return_value=status), \
             patch("roc.clients.load_sources", return_value={"drive": {"2008-06": {}}}), \
             patch("roc.clients.fetch") as fetch:
            link.wait_for_exe("2008-06", log=lambda *a: None)
        assert fetch.called, "%s must be downloaded for byte matching" % status

def test_link_click_downloads_the_compiler_once_then_stops():
    """A link click fetches the compiler the client was built with, exactly once."""
    from roc import link
    url = ("roconstruct://work?user=colin&client=2008-06&server=host:8765")
    fetched = []
    entry = {"exe": "Roblox.exe", "sha256": "abc", "compiler_build": 21022, "compiler": "VS2008 RTM"}
    # cloud? yes, then Enter through the model / mode / workers / advanced menus
    def answers(prompt=""):
        if "cloud model" in prompt:
            return "y"
        return ""

    def click(compilers):
        with temp_config() as link, \
             patch("roc.clients.load", return_value={"2008-06": entry}), \
             patch("roc.clients.exe_path", return_value=Path("Roblox.exe")), \
             patch("roc.clients.status", return_value="ok"), \
             patch("roc.setup.compilers", return_value=compilers), \
             patch("roc.setup.FETCHERS", {21022: lambda: fetched.append(21022)}), \
             patch("roc.setup.compilers.cache_clear"), \
             patch("roc.link.wait_for_exe"), \
             patch("roc.analyze.analyze"), \
             patch("roc.worker.main_args", return_value="ran") as run_worker, \
             patch("roc.worker.save_settings"), \
             patch("roc.worker.load_settings", return_value={"user": "colin"}), \
             patch("roc.worker.keep_awake"), \
             patch("roc.providers.is_cloud", return_value=True), \
             patch("roc.providers.available", return_value=True), \
             patch("roc.worker.cloud_default", return_value="deepseek:deepseek-flash"), \
             patch("roc.draft.ollama_models", return_value=[]), \
             patch("roc.draft.pick_model", return_value="deepseek:deepseek-flash"), \
             patch("roc.telemetry.profile", return_value=None), \
             patch("builtins.input", answers):
            link.run(url)
        return run_worker.call_args

    first = click({})
    assert fetched == [21022], "the compiler for this client is fetched on first click"
    payload = first.args[0]
    assert payload["client"] == "2008-06" and payload["mode"] == "cloud" and payload["cloud"] is True

    second = click({21022: "cl"})
    assert fetched == [21022], "a second click must not download the compiler again"
    assert second.args[0]["user"] == "colin"

def test_website_starts_the_worker_with_one_click():
    """The website keeps no dialog: every "Help out" is a roconstruct:// link.

    The protocol handler does the fetching, analysing and running, so a click on
    the page is the whole setup. The knobs stay available in `roc launch`.
    """
    page = (ROOT / "docs" / "index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    flat = " ".join(page.split())
    assert 'id="app"' in page, "the page needs its main container"
    # the links are built from the live client list and the published server
    assert 'href="roconstruct://work?${q}"' in page, "Help out must be a protocol link"
    assert "new URLSearchParams({client: name, server: progress.server})" in flat
    # the link decides nothing about the model: that is asked in the console
    assert 'mode: "cloud"' not in flat, "the link must not pre-pick the model path"
    assert 'cloud: "1"' not in flat, "the link must not pre-give cloud consent"
    assert "roc launch" in flat
    # ... and nothing that used to stand between the click and the worker
    for gone in ('<dialog', "id=\"setup\"", "showModal()", "location.href = url",
                 "localStorage", "su-user", "su-cloud"):
        assert gone not in page, "the setup prompt is back: %s" % gone


def test_a_website_link_asks_cloud_or_local_then_runs():
    """The link carries client+server only; the console picks the model path.

    Answering the cloud question yes must send the chosen options through to the
    worker; answering no must go down the local branch, where Ollama is offered.
    """
    from roc import link
    url = "roconstruct://work?client=2007-08&server=https%3A%2F%2Fcolinpc.tail2879d0.ts.net"
    parts = link.parse_full(url)
    assert parts == {"client": "2007-08", "server": "https://colinpc.tail2879d0.ts.net"}, parts

    def run_click(answer, settings, stub_local, stub_cloud):
        with temp_config() as link, \
             patch("roc.link.parse_full", return_value=parts), \
             patch("roc.link.wait_for_exe"), \
             patch("roc.analyze.analyze"), \
             patch("roc.worker.load_settings", return_value=settings), \
             patch("roc.worker.save_settings"), \
             patch("roc.clients.load", return_value={"2007-08": {"compiler_build": 21022,
                                                                 "compiler": "VS2008 RTM",
                                                                 "exe": "RobloxApp.exe"}}), \
             patch("roc.setup.compilers", return_value={21022: "cl"}), \
             patch("roc.link.choose_options", side_effect=stub_cloud), \
             patch("roc.link.choose_local", side_effect=stub_local), \
             patch("roc.worker.keep_awake"), \
             patch("roc.worker.main_args", return_value="ran") as run, \
             patch("builtins.input", lambda prompt="": answer):
            link.run(url)
        return run

    def cloud_choices(settings):
        return "deepseek:deepseek-flash", 4, 256, True, 6, 4096, "auto"

    def local_choices(settings, wanted):
        raise AssertionError("cloud was chosen, so the local branch must not run")

    run = run_click("y", {"user": "colin", "known_servers": []}, local_choices, cloud_choices)
    assert run.called, "a click must reach the worker"
    payload, argv = run.call_args.args
    assert payload["client"] == "2007-08" and payload["cloud"] is True
    assert payload["mode"] == "cloud" and payload["model"] == "deepseek:deepseek-flash"
    assert argv == ["--workers", "6", "--order", "auto", "--verbosity", "auto",
                    "--lease-mode", "function", "--rounds", "4", "--max-size", "256"]

    def cloud_refused(settings):
        raise AssertionError("the local branch must run when cloud is declined")

    def local_choices(settings, wanted):
        return "qwen2.5-coder:7b", 2, 96, False, 1, 2048, "auto"

    run = run_click("", {"user": "colin", "known_servers": []}, local_choices, cloud_refused)
    payload, argv = run.call_args.args
    assert payload["cloud"] is False and payload["mode"] == "local"
    assert payload["model"] == "qwen2.5-coder:7b"
    assert argv == ["--workers", "1", "--order", "auto", "--verbosity", "auto",
                    "--lease-mode", "function", "--rounds", "2", "--max-size", "96", "--no-revng"]


def test_cloud_consent_is_asked_once_and_remembered():
    """Declining or agreeing must not re-ask on every click."""
    from roc import link
    url = "roconstruct://work?client=2007-08&server=host:8765"
    parts = link.parse_full(url)
    asked = []

    def choose_options(settings):
        return "deepseek:deepseek-flash", 4, 256, True, 1, 2048, "auto"

    with temp_config() as link, \
         patch("roc.link.parse_full", return_value=parts), \
         patch("roc.link.wait_for_exe"), \
         patch("roc.analyze.analyze"), \
         patch("roc.worker.load_settings",

"""Tests for the cloud-first install: signed handoff, doctor, packages, idempotency.

Run directly (no pytest needed):  py -3.12 tests/test_install.py

import json
import re
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


class temp_root:
    """Point roc.setup at a throwaway tree so tests never touch real work."""

    def __enter__(self):
        self.dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="roc-install-test-"))
        (self.dir / "work" / "2008-06").mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.dir / "src" / "2008-06").mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.dir / "work" / "2008-06" / "functions.jsonl").write_text("{}\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (self.dir / "src" / "2008-06" / "00000000.cpp").write_text("int f() { return 0; }\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (self.dir / "roconstruct-settings.json").write_text('{"user":"colin"}', encoding="utf-8")
        self.patches = [patch("roc.setup.ROOT", self.dir),
                        patch("roc.setup.TOOLS", self.dir / "tools"),
                        patch("roc.setup.DL", self.dir / "tools" / "dl"),
                        patch("roc.setup.WINE_PREFIX", self.dir / "tools" / "wineprefix"),
                        patch("roc.setup.STATE", self.dir / "tools" / "install-state.json")]
        for item in self.patches:
            item.start()
        return self.dir

    def __exit__(self, *error):
        for item in reversed(self.patches):
            item.stop()
        import shutil
        shutil.rmtree(self.dir, ignore_errors=True)


class temp_config:
    """Redirect the signed worker config and the settings file it writes."""

    def __enter__(self):
        import roc.link as link
        self.dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="roc-handoff-test-"))
        # Patch the module attributes only. Assigning the globals directly and
        # patching them afterwards leaks the temp paths past __exit__, so every
        # later test in the process would read settings from a deleted folder.
        self.patches = [patch("roc.link.CONFIG", self.dir / "roconstruct-worker.json"),
                        patch("roc.worker.SETTINGS", self.dir / "roconstruct-settings.json")]
        for item in self.patches:
            item.start()
        return link

    def __exit__(self, *error):
        for item in reversed(self.patches):
            item.stop()
        import shutil
        shutil.rmtree(self.dir, ignore_errors=True)
        return False

def test_download_resumes_an_interrupted_transfer():
    """An interrupted download continues from the .part file instead of starting over."""
    import io
    from roc import setup
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        dest = Path(tmp) / "bundle.zip"
        part = dest.with_suffix(dest.suffix + ".part")
        part.write_bytes(b"first-half")
        asked = []

        class Response(io.BytesIO):
            status = 206
            headers = {"Content-Length": str(len(b"-second-half"))}

        def fake_urlopen(request, timeout=0):
            asked.append(request.headers.get("Range"))
            return Response(b"-second-half")

        with patch("roc.setup.urllib.request.urlopen", fake_urlopen), \
             patch("builtins.print"):
            assert setup.download("http://example/bundle.zip", dest) == dest

@pytest.mark.parametrize('lose_body', [False, True])
def test_interrupted_baseline_resumes_compile_but_reruns_all_gates(promotions, monkeypatch, lose_body):
    source = promotions.root / 'tools/rbxgs/Client/App/Test.cpp'
    source.write_text('old')
    job_id = promotions.submit('alice', upload(promotions.claim('alice', 'pc')['claims']))['id']
    job = promotions.take()
    snapshots, builds, gates = [], [], []
    interrupted = True
    def snapshot(root, destination, link=False):
        snapshots.append((destination, link))
        destination.mkdir(parents=True)
        if not link:
            layer = destination / 'rebuild/2008-06/out/RbxgsApp/layer-rbxgs'
            layer.mkdir(parents=True)
            (layer / 'a.obj').write_bytes(b'unverified live object')
    def build(root, progress):
        nonlocal interrupted
        builds.append(root)
        baseline = root.parent.name == 'baselines'
        if baseline:
            obj = root / 'rebuild/2008-06/out/RbxgsApp/layer-rbxgs/a.obj'
            if interrupted:
                assert not obj.exists()
                obj.write_bytes(b'compiled privately')
                interrupted = False
                raise RuntimeError('interrupted compile')
            assert obj.read_bytes() == b'compiled privately'
            (root / 'integration-linked.json').write_text('["00500000"]')
        result = gate_result()
        if not baseline:
            result['report']['owned_addrs'] = ['00500001'] if lose_body else ['00500000', '00500001']
            result['distinct'] += 1
        return result
    original = integration_verify.check_gates
    def check(result, baseline=None, elsewhere=frozenset()):
        gates.append(baseline is None)
        return original(result, baseline, elsewhere)
    monkeypatch.setattr(integration_verify, 'snapshot', snapshot)
    monkeypatch.setattr(integration_verify, 'run', lambda *args: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(integration_verify, 'verify_build', build)
    monkeypatch.setattr(integration_verify, 'check_gates', check)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match='interrupted compile'):
        integration_verify.verify(promotions, job)
    index = json.loads((promotions.directory / 'baselines/index.json').read_text())
    cached = promotions.root / next(iter(index.values()))
    assert (cached / 'integration-prepared.json').exists() and not (cached / 'integration-result.json').exists()
    if lose_body:
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='losing'):
            integration_verify.verify(promotions, job)
    else:
        receipt = integration_verify.verify(promotions, job)
        assert receipt['accepted'] and receipt['new_distinct'] == ['00500001']
    assert builds[:2] == [cached, cached] and gates == [True, False]
    assert len(snapshots) == 2 and snapshots[1][1] is True

def test_verify_build_runs_header_gates_beside_the_build(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    built, order = threading.Event(), []

    def run(root, args, log):
        name = log.name
        order.append((name, built.is_set()))
        if name == "integration-build.log":
            # the header gates must already be running: the build waits for them instead of racing
            for _ in range(500):
                if {"integration-size.log", "integration-base.log"} <= {n for n, _ in order}:
                    break
                threading.Event().wait(0.01)
            built.set()

    monkeypatch.setattr(integration_verify, "run", run)
    monkeypatch.setattr(integration_verify, "collect", lambda root: "ok")
    assert integration_verify.verify_build(tmp_path, lambda phase: None) == "ok"
    seen = dict(order)
    assert order[0][0] == "integration-overlay.log"
    assert seen["integration-size.log"] is False and seen["integration-base.log"] is False
    assert seen["integration-milestones.log"] is True and seen["integration-status.log"] is True

def test_windows_overlay_alias_preserves_accepted_fp_pragma(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from roc import rebuild
    source = tmp_path / 'tools/rbxgs/Client/App/gui/GUI.cpp'

    source.write_text('#include "gui/Gui.h"\n\t\tRBXASSERT(!focus);\n\t\treturn processNonFocus(event);')
    base = {'App/gui/GUI.cpp': [['#include "gui/Gui.h"\n', '#pragma float_control(precise, off)\n#include "gui/Gui.h"\n']]}
    edits = {'App/gui/Gui.cpp': [['\t\tRBXASSERT(!focus);\n\t\treturn processNonFocus(event);', '\t\treturn processNonFocus(event);']]}
    combined, kept, dropped = integration_verify.preflight(tmp_path, base, edits)
    assert list(combined) == ['App/gui/GUI.cpp'] and not dropped
    assert integration.overlay_delta(base, combined) == kept
    registry = tmp_path / 'patches.json'
    registry.write_text(json.dumps(combined))
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, 'ROOT', tmp_path)
    spec = {'root': 'tools/rbxgs/Client', 'patches': 'patches.json'}
    _, overlay = rebuild.build_overlay('2008-06', 'RbxgsApp', spec)
    text = (overlay / 'App/gui/GUI.cpp').read_text()
    assert text.startswith('#pragma float_control(precise, off)') and 'RBXASSERT' not in text
    registry.write_text(json.dumps(dict(base, **edits)))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='Case-colliding'):
        rebuild.build_overlay('2008-06', 'RbxgsApp', spec)
    assert (overlay / 'App/gui/GUI.cpp').read_text() == text

@pytest.mark.parametrize('mode',['absolute','relative','drive','unicode-case'])
def test_input_fingerprint_fast_labels_preserve_original_digest(tmp_path, mode):
    import hashlib
    if mode == 'unicode-case' and os.name != 'nt':
        pytest.skip('Windows Unicode case alias')
    root = (Path('relative-root') if mode == 'relative' else Path(tmp_path.anchor) if mode == 'drive'
            else Path('C:/native/İ') if mode == 'unicode-case' else tmp_path/'root')
    paths = [root,root/'file.cpp',root/'nested/header.h',root/'../sibling/file.cpp',
             root.parent/(root.name+'-other')/'same-prefix.h',tmp_path/'outside/header.h']
    if mode == 'unicode-case':
        paths.append(Path('c:/NATIVE/i\u0307/Header.h'))
    contents = {path:hashlib.sha256(str(path).encode()).digest() for path in paths}
    before = hashlib.sha256(b'native-inputs-v2\0')
    for path in sorted(set(paths),key=str):
        label = path.relative_to(root).as_posix() if path.is_relative_to(root) else str(path)
        before.update(label.encode()+b'\0'+contents[path])
    for name in ('INCLUDE','LIB','LIBPATH','CL','_CL_','PATH','WINEPREFIX','ROC_CL','ROC_WINSDK','ROC_ATLMFC'):
        before.update(name.encode()+b'='+os.environ.get(name,'').encode())
    assert integration_verify.digest_paths(root,paths,contents) == before.hexdigest()

@pytest.mark.parametrize('committed', [False, True])
def test_gateway_submission_recovers_exact_saved_intent_without_duplicate(promotions, committed):
    from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs
    directory = promotions.root / 'work/integration-client'
    claims = promotions.claim('alice', 'pc')['claims']
    body = upload(claims)
    original_generator = promotions.generator.read_bytes()
    folder = directory / 'requests' / integration.submission_key(body)
    calls = []
    class Api:
        fail = True
        def call(self, path, payload=None):
            if payload is None:
                query = {k: v[0] for k, v in parse_qs(urlparse(path).query).items()}
                return promotions.status(request=query['request'], user=query['user'], include_claims=True)
            calls.append(payload)
            if self.fail:
                self.fail = False
                if committed:
                    promotions.submit('alice', payload)
                raise worker.ApiFailure('server_fail', 'gateway timeout')
            return promotions.submit('alice', payload)
    api = Api()
    if committed:
        result = integration.submit_intent(api, directory, folder, body, promotions.generator, promotions.generator,
                                           {'applied_paths': ['App/Test.cpp']})
    else:
        with pytest.raises(worker.ApiFailure):
            integration.submit_intent(api, directory, folder, body, promotions.generator, promotions.generator,
                                      {'applied_paths': ['App/Test.cpp']})
        assert json.loads((folder / 'submission.json').read_text()) == body
        promotions.generator.write_bytes(b'# unrelated local edits after gateway failure\n')
        result = integration.resume_pending(api, directory, 'alice')[0]
    assert result['state'] == 'queued'
    assert promotions.store.db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM integration_jobs').fetchone()[0] == 1
    assert all(item == body for item in calls)
    assert json.loads((directory / 'claims' / claims[0]['id'] / 'job.json').read_text())['id'] == result['id']
    assert (directory / 'jobs' / result['id'] / 'submitted-generator.py').read_bytes() == original_generator
    if not committed:
        assert promotions.generator.read_bytes() == b'# unrelated local edits after gateway failure\n'
    assert not integration.resume_pending(api, directory, 'alice')

def test_interrupted_baseline_resumes_compile_but_reruns_all_gates(promotions, monkeypatch, lose_body):
    source = promotions.root / 'tools/rbxgs/Client/App/Test.cpp'
    source.write_text('old')

    snapshots, builds, gates = [], [], []
    interrupted = True
    def snapshot(root, destination, link=False):
        snapshots.append((destination, link))
        destination.mkdir(parents=True)

            layer = destination / 'rebuild/2008-06/out/RbxgsApp/layer-rbxgs'
            layer.mkdir(parents=True)
            (layer / 'a.obj').write_bytes(b'unverified live object')
    def build(root, progress):
        nonlocal interrupted
        builds.append(root)
        baseline = root.parent.name == 'baselines'
        if baseline:
            obj = root / 'rebuild/2008-06/out/RbxgsApp/layer-rbxgs/a.obj'

            (root / 'integration-linked.json').write_text('["00500000"]')
        result = gate_result()
        if not baseline:
            result['report']['owned_addrs'] = ['00500001'] if lose_body else ['00500000', '00500001']
            result['distinct'] += 1
        return result
    original = integration_verify.check_gates

        return original(result, baseline, elsewhere)

    monkeypatch.setattr(integration_verify, 'run', lambda *args: None)

    try:

        with pytest.raises(worker.ApiFailure):

import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import pytest
from roc import native_batch, native_sweep


def fixture(tmp_path, count=4):
    text='\n'.join('int A::f%d(){return %d;}'%(n,n) for n in range(count))
    candidates=[dict(method='A::f%d'%n,targets=['%08x'%n],edits=[['A::f%d(){return %d;}'%(n,n),'A::f%d(){return %d;}'%(n,100+n)]]) for n in range(count)]
    compiled=[]
    def compile(source,label):
        compiled.append(source)
        path=tmp_path/(label+'.obj');path.write_text(source)
        return dict(ok='BROKEN' not in source,object=str(path),source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),error='compile error' if 'BROKEN' in source else None)
    def scan(data):
        text=data.decode()
        result=[{'addr':'keeper','symbol':'keep'}] if 'LOSE_KEEPER' not in text else []
        return result+[{'addr':'%08x'%n,'symbol':'f%d'%n} for n in range(count) if 'return %d;'%(100+n) in text]
    return text,candidates,compile,SimpleNamespace(scan=scan),compiled


def test_twenty_worker_methods_share_one_compile_and_one_consistent_proof(tmp_path):
    text,candidates,compile,matcher,compiled=fixture(tmp_path,20)
    proposal,trials=native_batch.prove('App/util/A.cpp',text,candidates,{'keeper'},compile,matcher,lambda _:None)
    assert len(compiled)==1 and len(proposal['witnesses'])==20
    assert native_sweep.apply_edits(text,proposal['edits'])==compiled[-1]
    assert proposal['proof']['source_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(compiled[-1].encode()).hexdigest()
    assert proposal['proof']['losses']==[]


@pytest.mark.parametrize('bad',['BROKEN','LOSE_KEEPER'])
def test_bad_worker_is_isolated_and_remaining_methods_reproved_together(tmp_path,bad):
    text,candidates,compile,matcher,compiled=fixture(tmp_path)
    candidates[1]['edits'][0][1]='A::f1(){return '+bad+';}'
    proposal,trials=native_batch.prove('App/util/A.cpp',text,candidates,{'keeper'},compile,matcher,lambda _:None)
    assert {h['addr'] for h in proposal['witnesses']}=={'00000000','00000002','00000003'}
    assert bad not in native_sweep.apply_edits(text,proposal['edits'])
    assert proposal['proof']['losses']==[]
    assert native_sweep.apply_edits(text,proposal['edits'])==Path(proposal['proof']['object']).read_text()
    failed = [r for r in trials if not r['ok']]
    if bad == 'BROKEN':
        assert failed and all(r['losses'] == [] and not r['comparison_complete'] for r in failed)
    else:
        assert any(r['losses'] == ['keeper'] and r['comparison_complete'] for r in trials)

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from roc import native_sweep as sweep


def test_recovery_archive_is_immutable_versioned_and_keeps_original_model(tmp_path):
    proposals = [dict(file='App/A.cpp', base_revision='old', edits=[['old', 'new']])]
    ticket = sweep.hold_proposals(tmp_path, proposals, 'old', model='codex:original')
    selected, archive = sweep.pending_proposals(tmp_path, 'new')
    assert selected == ticket
    before = archive.read_bytes()
    assert json.loads(before) == proposals
    assert json.loads(ticket.read_text())['model'] == 'codex:original'
    assert json.loads(ticket.read_text())['attempted_revision'] == 'new'
    assert sweep.pending_proposals(tmp_path, 'new') == (ticket, archive)  # interrupted recheck resumes
    assert archive.read_bytes() == before
    archive.write_bytes(before+b' ')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='hash mismatch'):
        sweep.pending_proposals(tmp_path, 'new')

    ticket = sweep.hold_proposals(tmp_path, [], 'old', state='blocked', model='claude:original')
    assert sweep.pending_proposals(tmp_path, 'old') == (None, None)
    assert sweep.pending_proposals(tmp_path, 'new')[0] == ticket
    record = json.loads(ticket.read_text())
    sweep.integration.atomic_json(ticket, dict(record, state='done'))

def test_rebase_uses_only_exact_unique_original_or_already_applied_anchors():

    assert sweep.rebase_saved_edits('already', [['','already']]) == []

@pytest.mark.parametrize('case', ['valid','covered','integrated','lost','compile-error','definitions','ambiguous','baseline-error'])
def test_saved_recheck_preserves_compiler_data_ownership_and_loss_gates(tmp_path, monkeypatch, case):
    text = 'int A::f(){return 1;} int A::keep(){return 9;}'
    if case == 'covered':
        text = text.replace('return 1;', 'return 100;')
    calls = []
    def compile(source, rel, label, output, *args, **kwargs):
        calls.append(label)
        path = output/(label+'.obj')
        path.write_text(source)
        return dict(ok=not (case == 'baseline-error' and label == 'recheck-baseline' or
                            case == 'compile-error' and label == 'recheck-final'),
                    object=str(path), undefined_symbols=['required'] if case == 'definitions' else [])
    def scan(data):
        text = data.decode()
        hits = [] if case == 'lost' and 'return 100;' in text else [dict(addr='keeper',symbol='keep')]
        return hits + ([dict(addr='target',symbol='fresh-symbol')] if 'return 100;' in text else [])
    monkeypatch.setattr(sweep, 'compile_unit', compile)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sweep, 'claim_unit', lambda *args:'RBX::A')
    monkeypatch.setattr(sweep, 'ownership_candidates', lambda obj,hits:{'target':['target','other'] if case == 'ambiguous' else ['target']})
    ctx = SimpleNamespace(tree=tmp_path, overlay=tmp_path, includes=[], defines='', flags='',
        matcher=SimpleNamespace(scan=scan), integrated={'target'} if case == 'integrated' else set(),
        by_addr={'target':{'unit':'RBX::A'}})
    proposal = dict(file='App/A.cpp', base_revision='old', edits=[['return 1;', 'return 100;']],
        witnesses=[dict(addr='target',symbol='old-symbol',claim_unit='RBX::A')], proof=dict(defined_symbols=['required']))
    if case in ('lost','compile-error','definitions','baseline-error'):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='lost exact|compile failed|required definitions'):
            sweep.recheck_proposal(proposal, ctx, {'App/A.cpp':text}, tmp_path, 'new', lambda _:None, recover=True)
    else:
        result = sweep.recheck_proposal(proposal, ctx, {'App/A.cpp':text}, tmp_path, 'new', lambda _:None, recover=True)
        if case in ('covered','integrated','ambiguous'):
            assert result is None
            assert len(calls) == (2 if case == 'ambiguous' else 1)
        else:
            assert result['base_revision'] == 'new'
            assert result['proof']['losses'] == []
            assert result['witnesses'] == [dict(addr='target',symbol='fresh-symbol',claim_unit='RBX::A')]

"""Real Windows startup regression: controller is actively reading its stdin pipe."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

import pytest


@pytest.mark.skipif(os.name != 'nt', reason='Windows inherited synchronous stdin pipe blocks Python startup')
@pytest.mark.parametrize('operation', ['generator', 'verifier', 'compiler_wrapper', 'controller_shutdown'])
def test_native_child_starts_while_controller_command_reader_waits(tmp_path, operation):
    generator = tmp_path/'generator.py'
    marker = tmp_path/'result.txt'
    generator.write_text('from pathlib import Path\nPath(__file__).with_name("result.txt").write_text("proved")\n')
    script = r'''
import json,os,subprocess,sys,threading,time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
os.environ['PYTHONPATH']=sys.argv[1]
from roc import integration,integration_verify,rebuild,gui_worker
folder=Path(sys.argv[2]);operation=sys.argv[3]
reader=(lambda:list(gui_worker.command_lines(sys.stdin))) if operation=='controller_shutdown' else (lambda:os.read(sys.stdin.fileno(),1))
threading.Thread(target=reader,daemon=True).start()
time.sleep(.1)
started=time.monotonic()
if operation=='controller_shutdown':
 (folder/'result.txt').write_text('proved')
elif operation=='generator':
 integration.run_generator(folder/'generator.py',folder,timeout=2)
elif operation=='verifier':
 integration_verify.tool_inventory=lambda:dict(sdk='fixture',ml='fixture',toolchain=dict(build=21022,cl=sys.executable))
 integration_verify.run(folder,['-c','from pathlib import Path; Path("result.txt").write_text("proved")'],folder/'verify.log')
else:
 rebuild.env=lambda _:dict(os.environ)
 code,text=rebuild.run({'cl':sys.executable},'cl',['-c','from pathlib import Path; Path("result.txt").write_text("proved")'],folder,timeout=2)
 assert code==0,text
print(json.dumps({'seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'result':(folder/'result.txt').read_text()}),flush=True)
'''
    process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-u','-c',script,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]),str(tmp_path),operation],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
    try:
        # Keep the control pipe open. communicate() would close it and mask the bug.
        process.wait(timeout=8)
        output = process.stdout.read().decode(errors='replace')
        assert process.returncode == 0,output
        row = json.loads(output.splitlines()[-1])
        assert row['result'] == 'proved' and marker.read_text() == 'proved'
        assert row['seconds'] < 2
    finally:
        process.stdin.close()
        if process.poll() is None:
            subprocess.run(['taskkill','/PID',str(process.pid),'/T','/F'],stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,capture_output=True,
                           creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
            process.wait(timeout=5)

def test_queued_gate_waiter_gets_original_auth_failure():

    outcomes = []

        except providers.ProviderError as error:

    thread = threading.Thread(target=waiting)

    calls = []

        return rebuild.compile_direct('2008-06', [source], out, includes, defines, flags)

        path.write_bytes(data[:-1] + bytes([data[-1] ^ 1]))

    elif change == 'object':
        (out / 'unit.obj').write_bytes(b'broken')
    elif change == 'new_header':
        (includes[1] / header_name).write_text('int shadow;')
    elif change == 'include_order':
        includes.reverse()
    elif change in ('unrelated_source', 'unrelated_header'):
        (includes[1] / ('other.cpp' if change == 'unrelated_source' else 'other.h')).write_text('int other;')
    build('/O1' if change == 'flags' else '/O2', 'OTHER' if change == 'defines' else 'WIN32')

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import threading

import pytest

from roc import libs, rebuild


def tree_fixture(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    source = tmp_path / 'vendor'
    source.mkdir()
    (source / 'unit.cpp').write_text('int f(){return 1;}')
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, 'ROOT', tmp_path / 'private')
    monkeypatch.setattr(libs, 'LIBS', tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setitem(libs.RECIPES, 'test-tree', {
        'src': 'vendor', 'patches': {'unit.cpp': [['return 1;', 'return 2;']]}})
    return source


def test_patched_tree_retries_windows_directory_lock_without_recopy(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    source = tree_fixture(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    rename = Path.rename
    calls = []
    def locked_once(path, target):
        calls.append(path)
        if len(calls) == 1:
            error = PermissionError('scanner has directory open')
            error.winerror = 5
            raise error
        return rename(path, target)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, 'rename', locked_once)
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild.time, 'sleep', lambda _: None)
    tree = rebuild.patched_tree('2008-06', 'test-tree')
    assert len(calls) == 2 and calls[0] == calls[1]
    assert (tree / 'unit.cpp').read_text() == 'int f(){return 2;}'
    assert (source / 'unit.cpp').read_text() == 'int f(){return 1;}'
    assert rebuild.patched_tree('2008-06', 'test-tree') == tree
    assert len(calls) == 2


def test_concurrent_tree_builders_do_not_delete_each_others_temporary_source(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    tree_fixture(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    copy = shutil.copytree
    barrier = threading.Barrier(2)
    temporary = []
    def copying(source, target, **kwargs):
        result = copy(source, target, **kwargs)
        temporary.append(target)
        barrier.wait(timeout=5)
        return result
    monkeypatch.setattr(shutil, 'copytree', copying)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as pool:
        results = list(pool.map(lambda _: rebuild.patched_tree('2008-06', 'test-tree'), range(2)))
    assert results[0] == results[1]
    assert len(set(temporary)) == 2
    assert (results[0] / 'unit.cpp').read_text() == 'int f(){return 2;}'


def test_real_permissions_failure_stays_visible_with_diagnostic_copy(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    tree_fixture(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    def denied(*_):
        raise PermissionError('permanent access denial')
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, 'rename', denied)
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError, match='permanent'):
        rebuild.patched_tree('2008-06', 'test-tree')
    copies = list((rebuild.workspace('2008-06') / 'out/trees').glob('*.tmp'))
    assert len(copies) == 1
    assert (copies[0] / 'unit.cpp').read_text() == 'int f(){return 2;}'


def test_private_build_skips_public_progress_scan(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv('ROC_INTEGRATOR_PRIVATE', '1')
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, 'workspace', lambda _: pytest.fail('private build scanned public progress'))
    assert rebuild.progress() is None

def fake_obj(code, relocs):
    """Minimal i386 COFF: one section, one function symbol `_f`."""
    relptr = 60 + len(code)
    symptr = relptr + 10 * len(relocs)
    head = struct.pack("<HHIIIHH", 0x14C, 1, 0, symptr, 1, 0, 0)
    sec = struct.pack("<8sIIIIIIHHI", b".text$mn", 0, 0, len(code), 60, relptr, 0, len(relocs), 0, 0x60500020)
    rel = b"".join(struct.pack("<IIH", r, 0, 0x14) for r in relocs)
    sym = struct.pack("<8sIhHBB", b"_f", 0, 1, 0x20, 2, 0)
    return head + sec + code + rel + sym + struct.pack("<I", 4)

def test_cloud_provider_core():
    from roc import providers
    old_post = providers._post
    old_key = os.environ.get("NVIDIA_API_KEY")
    os.environ["NVIDIA_API_KEY"] = "test-key"
    try:
        providers._post = lambda *args: ({"id": "req1", "choices": [{"message": {"content": "```cpp\\nint f(){}\\n```"}, "finish_reason": "stop"}], "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 4, "completion_tokens": 7}}, {"x-request-id": "req1"})
        out = providers.generate("nvidia:qwen/test", r"C:\Users\alice\secret", options={"allow_cloud": True, "max_tokens": 8})
        assert out.provider == "nvidia" and out.model == "qwen/test" and out.input_tokens == 4
        assert "alice" not in out.state["messages"][0]["content"]
        listed = providers.generate("nvidia:qwen/test", [{"role": "system", "content": "short"},
                                                            {"role": "user", "content": "message-list"}],
                                    options={"allow_cloud": True, "max_tokens": 8})
        assert listed.text and listed.state["messages"][0]["role"] == "system"
        history = providers.generate("nvidia:qwen/test", [{"role": "system", "content": r"C:\Users\alice\private"},
                                                             {"role": "user", "content": "message-list"}],
                                      options={"allow_cloud": True, "max_tokens": 8})
        assert "alice" not in history.state["messages"][0]["content"]
        assert "private" not in providers.sanitize_prompt("token=private-token-value")
        old_secret_path = os.environ.get("ROCONSTRUCT_SECRETS_FILE")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            secret_path = Path(temp) / "secrets.json"
            secret_path.write_text(json.dumps({"DEEPSEEK_API_KEY": "file-key"}))
            os.environ["ROCONSTRUCT_SECRETS_FILE"] = str(secret_path)
            assert providers.key_available("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY")
            assert providers.secret("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY") == "file-key"
        if old_secret_path is None:
            os.environ.pop("ROCONSTRUCT_SECRETS_FILE", None)
        else:
            os.environ["ROCONSTRUCT_SECRETS_FILE"] = old_secret_path
        try:
            providers.save_provider("bad", "openai-chat", "https://example.com/v1?token=x", "BAD_KEY")
            raise AssertionError("secret query URL was accepted")
        except ValueError:
            pass
        try:

            raise AssertionError("cloud request was not blocked")
        except providers.ProviderError as error:
            assert error.category == "cloud_disabled"
        budget = providers.CloudBudget(requests=1, tokens=20)
        ticket = budget.reserve(8)

        except providers.ProviderError:

        lock = gate.enter("nvidia")
        lock.release()
        gate.done("nvidia", False)
        try:
            gate.enter("nvidia")
            raise AssertionError("circuit breaker was not enforced")
        except providers.ProviderError as error:
            assert error.category == "provider_circuit"
        gate.reset("nvidia")
        lock = gate.enter("nvidia")
        lock.release()
    finally:
        providers._post = old_post
        if old_key is None:
            os.environ.pop("NVIDIA_API_KEY", None)
        else:
            os.environ["NVIDIA_API_KEY"] = old_key


def test_opencode_cli_provider():
    """OpenCode models run through the signed-in CLI: no key, plan allowances."""
    from roc import providers
    old_which, old_run = providers.shutil.which, providers._opencode_run
    try:
        providers.shutil.which = lambda name: "C:\\npm\\opencode.cmd" if name == "opencode" else None
        provider, remote, config = providers.parse_model("opencode:opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash#high")
        assert provider == "opencode" and remote == "opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash#high"
        assert config["kind"] == "opencode-cli" and providers.provider_ready("opencode")
        assert "opencode auth login" in providers.credential_hint("opencode:opencode/x")
        runs = []

        def fake_run(argv, prompt, timeout):
            runs.append((argv, prompt))
            return 0, json.dumps({"type": "text", "part": {"text": "```cpp\nint f(){}\n```"}}) + "\n"

        providers._opencode_run = fake_run
        out = providers.generate("opencode:opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash#high", "write cpp",
                                 options={"allow_cloud": True, "max_tokens": 8})
        assert out.provider == "opencode" and out.model == "opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash#high"
        assert "int f(){}" in out.text
        assert runs[0][0][0].endswith("opencode.cmd")
        assert runs[0][0][1:] == ["run", "-m", "opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash#high", "--format", "json"]
        assert "write cpp" in runs[0][1] and "Reconstruct compact valid C++" in runs[0][1]
        try:
            providers.generate("opencode:opencode/x", "p", options={})
            raise AssertionError("cloud request was not blocked")
        except providers.ProviderError as error:
            assert error.category == "cloud_disabled"
        for error_body, category in (
                ({"type": "provider.quota", "message": "Insufficient account funds", "status": 402}, "provider_auth"),
                ({"type": "provider.no-route", "message": "Variant unavailable for opencode/glm-5.3-flash: bogus"},
                 "provider_error"),
                ({"type": "provider.quota", "message": "Rate limit exceeded.", "status": 429}, "provider_retry")):
            providers._opencode_run = lambda *args, error_body=error_body: (
                1, json.dumps({"type": "error", "error": error_body}) + "\n")
            try:
                providers.generate("opencode:opencode/x", "p", options={"allow_cloud": True, "retries": 0})
                raise AssertionError("run error was not raised")
            except providers.ProviderError as error:
                assert error.category == category and error_body["message"] in str(error)
        try:
            providers.generate("opencode:opencode/x", "p",
                              options={"allow_cloud": True, "budget": providers.CloudBudget(cost=1)})
            raise AssertionError("USD cap was accepted for a plan-allowance provider")
        except providers.ProviderError as error:
            assert error.category == "cloud_budget"
    finally:
        providers.shutil.which = old_which
        providers._opencode_run = old_run

def test_non_retryable_http_fails_fast():

    surface immediately: no retry loop, no repeated spend."""

    old_key = os.environ.get("NVIDIA_API_KEY")
    old_post = providers._post
    calls = []
    os.environ["NVIDIA_API_KEY"] = "test-key"
    def rejected(*args):
        calls.append(1)
        raise providers.ProviderError("provider_error", "HTTP 400", 400)
    try:
        providers._post = rejected
        try:
            providers.generate("nvidia:qwen/test", "p",
                               options={"allow_cloud": True, "retries": 2})
            raise AssertionError("rejected request did not fail")
        except providers.ProviderError as error:
            assert error.category == "provider_error" and error.status == 400
        assert len(calls) == 1
    finally:
        providers._post = old_post
        if old_key is None:
            os.environ.pop("NVIDIA_API_KEY", None)
        else:
            os.environ["NVIDIA_API_KEY"] = old_key

def test_announce_once():
    import threading
    from roc import worker
    worker._ANNOUNCED.clear()
    logged = []
    lock = threading.Lock()
    def log(message):
        with lock:
            logged.append(message)
    threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker.announce_once, args=(("k", "v"), log, "hello"))
               for _ in range(8)]
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join()
    assert logged == ["hello"]

    assert logged == ["hello", "world"]
    worker._ANNOUNCED.clear()

def test_mine_digest():

    st = Store(":memory:", lease_seconds=1)
    st.db.executemany("INSERT INTO funcs(client,addr,size,unit,score) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",
                      [("C", "a1", 9, "U1", 100), ("C", "a2", 9, "U2", 50), ("C", "a3", 9, "U3", 0)])
    now = time.time()
    st.db.executemany("INSERT INTO events(ts,client,addr,user,old,new) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                      [(now - 3600, "C", "a1", "alice", 90, 100),
                       (now - 1800, "C", "a2", "alice", 0, 50)])
    st.db.commit()
    assert st.user_points("alice") == 60 and st.user_points("nobody") == 0
    assert st.client_progress("C") == (1, 3)
    assert st.client_bytes("C") == (9, 27)

    sent = []

    with patch("roc.reports._post", side_effect=lambda url, payload: sent.append(payload)):
        log.submit({"client": "C", "addr": "a1", "unit": "U1", "size": 9}, "alice", "w", "m", 100, 10)
        log.submit({"client": "C", "addr": "a2", "unit": "U2", "size": 9}, "alice", "w", "m", 50, 50)
        assert sent == []  # batched, not spammed
        log.flush()

    assert server_embed["fields"][3]["name"] == "🏆 Workers"
    assert "alice" in str(server_embed)

    with patch("roc.worker.run", side_effect=fake_run), patch("roc.setup.compilers") as warmed:
        worker.run_concurrent("http://x", "u", model="m", max_jobs=3, workers=3, log=lambda *a: None)
        warmed.assert_called_once()
    assert len(calls) == 3
    assert {c[1]["examples_cache"] is calls[0][1]["examples_cache"] for c in calls} == {True}
    assert {c[1]["source_cache"] is calls[0][1]["source_cache"] for c in calls} == {True}
    assert sorted(c[0][7] for c in calls) == [1, 1, 1]
    calls.clear()
    with patch("roc.worker.run", side_effect=fake_run):
        worker.run_concurrent("http://x", "u", model="m", max_jobs=0, workers=99, log=lambda *a: None)
    assert len(calls) == 99

def test_shape_normalisation():
    # Same code with different constants must collapse to one shape, or the counts that
    # decide which template to write next are meaningless.
    a = ["mov eax, dword ptr [sym]", "push eax", "call sym", "add esp, 4",
         "mov dword ptr [sym], sym", "ret "]
    b = ["mov eax, dword ptr [sym]", "push eax", "call sym", "add esp, 8",
         "mov dword ptr [sym], sym", "ret "]
    assert fingerprint.shape_from_lines(a) == fingerprint.shape_from_lines(b)
    c = ["mov eax, dword ptr [sym]", "push eax", "call sym", "add esp, 4", "ret "]
    assert fingerprint.shape_from_lines(a) != fingerprint.shape_from_lines(c)
    # `ret 8` and `ret` are the same shape: the cleanup is implied by the arguments.
    d = ["mov eax, dword ptr [sym]", "push eax", "call sym", "add esp, 4",
         "mov dword ptr [sym], sym", "ret 8"]
    assert fingerprint.shape_from_lines(d) == fingerprint.shape_from_lines(a)
    # A member offset is not a constant and must survive normalisation, or every
    # `this->field` shape would collapse into one useless bucket.
    assert fingerprint.norm_line("mov dword ptr [ecx + 4], eax") == "mov dword ptr [ecx + #], eax"
    assert fingerprint.norm_line("mov dword ptr [ecx], eax") == "mov dword ptr [ecx], eax"
    assert fingerprint.norm_line("push 0") == "push #"
    # A relocated operand prints as `sym` already and must stay as it is.
    assert fingerprint.norm_line("call sym") == "call sym"
    # Runs of identical normalised lines collapse, so a zero-initialiser chain over
    # several fields is one shape rather than one per field count.
    r = ["mov dword ptr [ecx], 0", "mov dword ptr [ecx + 4], 0", "mov dword ptr [ecx + 8], 0"]
    assert fingerprint.shape_from_lines(r) == ("mov dword ptr [ecx], #", "mov dword ptr [ecx + #], #")


def test_xcopy_ordering():
    reg = {"A": {"compiler_build": 21022}, "B": {"compiler_build": 30729}}
    own = ("// own\nvoid f(){}\n", [("A", "00000001")])

def test_xcopy_batching_isolates_collisions():
    reg = {"A": {"compiler_build": 21022}}
    # Two candidates declaring the same name with different types: a single translation
    # unit without namespaces is C2371 and the whole chunk is lost.
    collide = [("extern int G1_VALUE;\nvoid NAME(){ G1_VALUE = 1; }\n", []),
               ("extern char* G1_VALUE;\nvoid NAME(){ G1_VALUE = 0; }\n", [])]
    text, by_tag = matchers._batch_cpp(collide)
    assert text.count("namespace ns_ROCX") == 2, "each candidate needs its own namespace"
    assert set(by_tag) == {"ROCX000000", "ROCX000001"}
    # C has no namespaces, so it is compiled one source per unit instead.
    c_src, c_by = matchers._batch_alone("extern int G1_VALUE;\nvoid NAME(){ G1_VALUE = 1; }\n")
    assert "namespace" not in c_src and len(c_by) == 1
    assert matchers._lang("// roc-lang: c\nvoid f(){}\n") == "c"
    assert matchers._lang("void f(){}\n") == "cpp"
    # A system header inside a namespace breaks the CRT headers ("fpos_t is not a member
    # of global namespace"), so anything with an include is compiled on its own too.
    stl = "#include <vector>\nstruct E { int v[4]; };\ntemplate class std::vector<E>;\n"
    assert matchers.needs_global_scope(stl)
    assert not matchers.needs_global_scope("extern int G;\nvoid f(){}\n")
    assert matchers.needs_global_scope("// roc-lang: c\nvoid f(){}\n")

def test_cdecl_member_and_free_function_convention_variants():
    from roc import match, mutate
    # member thiscall candidate (ret 4) vs __cdecl target (plain ret):
    # keyword must go on the in-class declaration, not the definition
    diag = {"return_cleanup": {"target": "", "candidate": "4"}}
    src = ("struct S {\n    void f(int a);\n};\n\nvoid S::f(int a) { int x = a; }\n")
    fixes = mutate.cdecl_member_variants(src, diag)
    assert fixes == ["struct S {\n    void __cdecl f(int a);\n};\n\nvoid S::f(int a) { int x = a; }\n"]
    assert mutate.cdecl_member_variants("void f(int a){ }", diag) == []
    # member whose body never uses this can become a free function
    free = mutate.free_function_variants(src, diag)
    assert free == ["struct S {\n};\n\nvoid __cdecl f(int a) { int x = a; }\n"]
    uses_this = "struct S { void f(int a); };\nvoid S::f(int a) { g(this); }\n"
    assert mutate.free_function_variants(uses_this, diag) == []
    # evidence-driven trigger: ret cleanup differs even when the classifier
    # called the mismatch something else
    mixed = match.diagnose(bytes.fromhex("7400c3"), [], bytes.fromhex("7500c20400"), [])
    assert mixed["mismatch_class"] == "branch-condition mismatch"
    assert mixed["return_cleanup"] == {"target": "", "candidate": "4"}
    variants = mutate.guided_variants(
        "struct S {\n    void f(int a);\n};\nvoid S::f(int a) { if (a > 0) g(); }", mixed)
    assert any(category == "calling_convention" for category, _ in variants)

def test_align_insns_scores_and_ops():
    """Instruction-alignment scoring adapted from cpp_permuter/decomp-permuter:
    register renaming is cheap, argument differences cost more, and a
    missing+extra instruction pair costs most."""
    from roc import match
    identical = match.align_insns(bytes.fromhex("b801000000"), [], bytes.fromhex("b801000000"), [])
    assert identical["cost"] == 0
    assert [s["op"] for s in identical["steps"]] == ["same"]
    regalloc = match.align_insns(bytes.fromhex("b801000000"), [], bytes.fromhex("bb01000000"), [])
    assert regalloc["cost"] == match.ALIGN_PENALTY_REGALLOC
    assert [s["op"] for s in regalloc["steps"]] == ["regalloc"]
    args = match.align_insns(bytes.fromhex("b801000000"), [], bytes.fromhex("b802000000"), [])
    assert args["cost"] == match.ALIGN_PENALTY_ARGS
    assert [s["op"] for s in args["steps"]] == ["args"]
    deleted = match.align_insns(bytes.fromhex("b80100000090"), [], bytes.fromhex("b801000000"), [])
    assert deleted["cost"] == match.ALIGN_PENALTY_DELETE
    assert [s["op"] for s in deleted["steps"]] == ["same", "del"]
    # relocation-only difference: the same instruction text once masked
    reloc = match.align_insns(bytes.fromhex("a100000000"), [0], bytes.fromhex("a100000000"), [0])
    assert reloc["cost"] == 0
    # different mnemonics never substitute: del+ins instead of a cheap arg swap
    multi = match.align_insns(bytes.fromhex("b801000000c3"), [], bytes.fromhex("b801000000c20400"), [])
    assert multi["cost"] >= match.ALIGN_PENALTY_ARGS


def test_permutation_transforms_are_semantics_preserving():
    from roc import mutate
    src = ("struct S {\n"
           "    int f(int a);\n"
           "};\n\n"
           "int S::f(int a) {\n"
           "    int v1;\n"
           "    int v2;\n\n"
           "    v1 = g(a) + h(a);\n"
           "    if (a >= 2)\n"
           "        v2 = a * 3;\n"
           "    return v1 + v2;\n"
           "}\n")
    swaps = mutate.commutative_swap_variants(src)
    assert any("h(a) + g(a)" in v for v in swaps)
    assert any("v2 + v1" in v for v in swaps)
    ineq = mutate.inequality_swap_variant(src)
    assert "2 <= a" in ineq
    decls = mutate.reorder_decls_variants(src)
    assert decls and decls[0].index("int v2;") < decls[0].index("int v1;")
    # blank-line structure between declarations is preserved
    assert "\n\n    v1 = g(a)" in decls[0]
    # every variant is distinct, the original never comes back
    variants = mutate.permute_variants(src, None)
    assert len({v for _, v in variants}) == len(variants)
    assert src not in {v for _, v in variants}

def test_mutate_validated():
    src = "struct S{ char m_x; }; int S::f(){ return m_x != 0; }"
    vs = mutate.variants(src)
    assert 1 <= len(vs) <= 4 and any("unsigned char" in v for v in vs)
    calls = []
    def fake_check(c, a, t, f=None):
        calls.append(t)
        if "unsigned char" in t:
            return (90, None, None, None)
        return (50, None, None, None)
    result = mutate.improve("C", "1", src, check=fake_check)
    best, out, tried, spec = result[0], result[1], result[2], result.speculative
    assert (best, tried) == (90, len(vs)) and "unsigned char" in out
    assert spec is False  # signedness toggle is semantics-preserving
    # old 3-unpacking callers keep working (mixed-version safety)
    legacy_score, legacy_src, legacy_tried = mutate.improve("C", "1", src, check=fake_check)
    assert (legacy_score, legacy_tried) == (90, len(vs))
    def boom(c, a, t, f=None):
        raise CompileError("nope")
    assert mutate.improve("C", "1", src, check=boom)[0] == 0
    neg = "int f(int a, int b)\n{\n    return a == b;\n}\n"
    def prefer_neg(c, a, t, f=None):
        return (80 if "!=" in t else 10, None, None, None)
    assert mutate.improve("C", "1", neg, check=prefer_neg).speculative is True

def test_selfupdate():
    from roc import setup
    import subprocess
    real_which, real_run = shutil.which, subprocess.run

    class Done:
        def __init__(self, code=0, out=""):
            self.returncode, self.stdout = code, out

    def run_case(which, sides, raises=None):
        import roc.setup as su
        su.shutil.which = lambda *a: which
        def fake_run(*args, **k):
            if raises:
                raise raises
            return sides.pop(0)
        su.subprocess.run = fake_run
        try:
            return su.try_update(log=lambda *a: None)
        finally:
            su.shutil.which, su.subprocess.run = real_which, real_run

    assert "git not installed" in run_case(None, [])
    with patch.object(Path, "exists", return_value=False):
        assert "not a git checkout" in run_case("git", [])
    assert "offline" in run_case("git", [Done(1)])                                    # fetch fails
    assert "current" in run_case("git", [Done(0), Done(0, "0\n")])                   # behind 0
    assert run_case("git", [Done(0), Done(0, "3\n"), Done(0)]) == "updated"  # pull ok
    assert "as-is" in run_case("git", [Done(0), Done(0, "3\n"), Done(1)])   # pull fails
    assert "as-is" in run_case("git", [], raises=subprocess.TimeoutExpired("git", 1))
    assert "as-is" in run_case("git", [], raises=OSError("nope"))


def test_repair_safety_guards():
    # namespaced qualifiers are never renamed, even with one class present
    ns = "struct V {\n    int x;\n};\nint RBX::VInstance::Create()\n{\n    return 0;\n}\n"
    assert _repair.ensure_member_declared(ns) is None
    # STL qualifiers are never renamed
    stl = "struct E {\n    int v[4];\n};\nint vector::size()\n{\n    return 0;\n}\n"
    assert _repair.ensure_member_declared(stl) is None
    # calling convention survives into the inserted declaration
    conv = "struct S {\n    int x;\n};\nint __stdcall S::f(int a)\n{\n    return a;\n}\n"
    fixed = _repair.ensure_member_declared(conv)
    assert fixed is not None and "int __stdcall f(int a);" in fixed
    # win typedefs only for identifiers the compiler reported missing
    wsrc = "struct W {\n    DWORD d;\n    int e;\n};\nint W::f()\n{\n    return d;\n}\n"
    assert _repair.add_win_typedefs(wsrc, "error C2065: 'DWORD' : undeclared") is not None
    assert _repair.add_win_typedefs(wsrc, "error C2065: 'HANDLE' : undeclared") is None
    assert "struct HDC__; typedef struct HDC__ *HDC;" in _repair.add_win_typedefs(
        "HDC h;", "error C2065: 'HDC' : undeclared")
    # `this` rename still fires with std:: mentions but no qualified definition
    free = "int g(std::vector<int>* v, X* this)\n{\n    return this->x;\n}\n"
    assert _repair.rename_this_identifier(free) is not None
    assert _repair.rename_this_identifier(
        "struct S {\n    int f();\n};\nint S::f()\n{\n    return this->x;\n}\n") is None

def test_find_functions_drops_fallthrough_starts():
    # push ebp; nops; mov ecx,esp (8B CC) falls into the aligned byte the int3 heuristic seeds.
    va = 0x401000
    code = bytes.fromhex("55" + "90" * 13 + "8bcc5dc3" + "cc" * 12)
    assert [f["addr"] for f in find_functions(code, va, {va}, [])] == ["00401000", "00401010"]
    assert [(f["addr"], f["size"]) for f in find_functions(code, va, {va}, [], keep={va})] == [("00401000", 18)]


def test_find_functions_ignores_trailing_jump_table():
    va = 0x0f000000  # table entries end in 0x0f, which cannot decode as a whole instruction
    table, case = va + 8, va + 7
    code = bytes.fromhex("ff2485") + table.to_bytes(4, "little") + bytes.fromhex("c3") + case.to_bytes(4, "little") * 2
    relocs = [va + 3, table, table + 4]
    assert find_functions(code, va, {va}, relocs)[0]["kind"] == "bad"
    assert find_functions(code, va, {va}, relocs, keep={va})[0]["kind"] == "code"


def test_find_functions_merges_catch_continuation():
    # catch funclet: mov eax, offset cont; ret -- cont is a label inside the catch symbol.
    va = 0x401000
    code = bytes.fromhex("b8") + (va + 6).to_bytes(4, "little") + bytes.fromhex("c35dc3")
    assert [f["addr"] for f in find_functions(code, va, {va}, [va + 1])] == ["00401000", "00401006"]
    merged = find_functions(code, va, {va}, [va + 1], keep={va})
    assert [(f["addr"], f["size"], f["kind"]) for f in merged] == [("00401000", 8, "eh")]


def test_unaligned_catch_funclet_returning_into_parent_is_eh():
    # parent: push ebp; ...; ret, then an unaligned funclet returning to the parent's middle.
    va = 0x401000
    code = bytes.fromhex("5590c3") + bytes.fromhex("b8") + (va + 1).to_bytes(4, "little") + bytes.fromhex("c3")
    rows = find_functions(code, va, {va, va + 3}, [va + 4], keep={va, va + 3})
    assert [(f["addr"], f["kind"]) for f in rows] == [("00401000", "code"), ("00401003", "eh")]

class _CalleeApi:
    def __init__(self):
        self.paths = []

    def call(self, path):
        self.paths.append(path)
        if "00401010" in path:
            return {"score": 100, "source": "extern \"C\" int __cdecl helper(int x);\nint helper(int x) { return x; }\n"}
        return {"score": 99, "source": "int partial();"}


def test_exact_callee_source_hints_are_bounded():

def test_repair_member_decl():
    fixed = _repair.ensure_member_declared("struct PAVX {\n    int* vtable;\n};\nint PAVX::f()\n{\n    return 0;\n}\n")
    assert fixed is not None and "int f();" in fixed
    # qualifier mismatch with a single class: S::f -> PAVX::f plus decl
    bad = "struct PAVX {\n    int* vtable;\n};\nint S::f()\n{\n    return 0;\n}\n"
    fixed = _repair.ensure_member_declared(bad)
    assert fixed is not None and "S::" not in fixed and "PAVX::f" in fixed
    # ambiguous with two classes: untouched
    two = "struct A {};\nstruct B {};\nint S::f()\n{\n    return 0;\n}\n"
    assert _repair.ensure_member_declared(two) is None


def test_repair_this_and_types():
    free = "int linked_f(Linked* this)\n{\n    return this->x;\n}\n"
    fixed = _repair.rename_this_identifier(free)
    assert fixed is not None and "this_" in fixed and re.search(r"\bthis\b", fixed) is None
    member = "struct S {\n    int f();\n};\nint S::f()\n{\n    return this->x;\n}\n"
    assert _repair.rename_this_identifier(member) is None  # valid use untouched
    typed = "struct H {\n    uint8_t b[4];\n    size_t n;\n};\nint H::g()\n{\n    return 0;\n}\n"
    fixed = _repair.add_fixedwidth_typedefs(typed)
    assert fixed is not None and "typedef unsigned char uint8_t;" in fixed
    assert _repair.nullptr_to_zero("int* p = nullptr;") == "int* p = 0;"
    assert _repair.parse_error_codes("source(7) : error C2039: x  source(8) : error C2143: y") == ["2039", "2143"]


def test_repair_sanitize_and_loop():
    src = "// roc-lib: seg_00430000\nint f()\n{\n    return 0;\n}\n"
    san, dropped = _repair.sanitize(src)
    assert dropped == 1 and "roc-lib" not in san
    calls = []
    def fake_check(client, addr, text, flags=None):
        calls.append(text)
        if "uint8_t" in text and "typedef" not in text:
            raise CompileError("source(4) : error C4430: missing type specifier")
        return 71, "f", "diff", []
    score, out, _, _, _, applied, err = _repair.repair_loop(
        "C", "1", "struct H {\n    uint8_t b;\n};\nint H::g()\n{\n    return 1;\n}\n",
        check=fake_check)
    assert err is None and score == 71 and "fixedwidth-typedefs" in applied
    assert len(calls) == 2  # no retry loop: one fail, one fixed recheck

def test_find_functions():
    base = 0x1000
    code = bytes.fromhex(
        "e807000000"        # 1000: call 100c
        "a1" "00200000"     # 1005: mov eax, [2000]  (reloc at 1006)
        "c3"                # 100a: ret
        "cc"                # 100b: padding
        "33c0" "c3"         # 100c: xor eax,eax; ret
        "cc"                # padding to 16
        "c3"                # 1010: ret, no caller: found by alignment
    )
    funcs = find_functions(code, base, {base}, [0x1006])
    assert funcs == [
        {"addr": "00001000", "size": 11, "relocs": [6], "calls": 1, "kind": "code"},
        {"addr": "0000100c", "size": 3, "relocs": [], "calls": 0, "kind": "code"},
        {"addr": "00001010", "size": 1, "relocs": [], "calls": 0, "kind": "code"},
    ], funcs
    assert asm_shape(bytes.fromhex("8b442404c3"), 0x1000) == "mov eax, dword ptr [esp + N] ; ret"

def fake_obj(code, relocs):
    """Minimal i386 COFF: one section, one function symbol `_f`."""
    relptr = 60 + len(code)
    symptr = relptr + 10 * len(relocs)
    head = struct.pack("<HHIIIHH", 0x14C, 1, 0, symptr, 1, 0, 0)
    sec = struct.pack("<8sIIIIIIHHI", b".text$mn", 0, 0, len(code), 60, relptr, 0, len(relocs), 0, 0x60500020)
    rel = b"".join(struct.pack("<IIH", r, 0, 0x14) for r in relocs)
    sym = struct.pack("<8sIhHBB", b"_f", 0, 1, 0x20, 2, 0)
    return head + sec + code + rel + sym + struct.pack("<I", 4)


def test_relocated_small_decimal_branch_operands_display_as_symbols():
    assert asm_lines(bytes.fromhex("e800000000c3"), [1]) == ["call sym", "ret "]
    assert asm_lines(bytes.fromhex("e900000000c3"), [1]) == ["jmp sym", "ret "]
    assert asm_lines(bytes.fromhex("e800000000c3"), []) == ["call 5", "ret "]


def test_match():
    obj = fake_obj(bytes.fromhex("e800000000c3"), [1])
    [(name, code, relocs)] = coff_functions(obj)
    assert (name, relocs) == ("_f", [1]), (name, relocs)
    # Same call to a different target in the exe: masked, so 100.
    assert score(bytes.fromhex("e812345678c3"), [], code, relocs) == 100
    assert score(bytes.fromhex("e812345678c2"), [], code, relocs) < 100
    assert asm_lines(bytes.fromhex("a100104000c3"), [1]) == ["mov eax, dword ptr [sym]", "ret "]
    reject_asm("#include <string>\n")
    for bad in ("__asm { nop }", "_emit 0x90", '#include "C:/secret.txt"', "#import <x.tlb>",
                '#pragma comment(lib, "x")'):
        try:
            reject_asm(bad)
            raise AssertionError(bad)
        except CompileError:
            pass
    reject_asm("int masm_count;")

def test_mass_helpers():
    from roc.matchers import ar_members
    from roc.match import directives
    from roc.libs import source_for
    obj = fake_obj(bytes.fromhex("e800000000c3"), [1])
    member = lambda name, body: name.ljust(16).encode() + b" " * 32 + str(len(body)).ljust(10).encode() + b"`\n" + body + b"\n" * (len(body) & 1)
    lib = b"!<arch>\n" + member("/", b"\0" * 4) + member("a.obj/", obj) + member("b/", b"\0\0\xff\xff" + b"\0" * 20)
    assert list(ar_members(lib)) == [obj]
    assert directives("// x\n// roc-lang: c\n// roc-cl: 30729\nint a;") == {"lang": "c", "cl": "30729"}
    d = directives(source_for("zlib-1.2.3", "sub\\x.c", "c", 21022, "/O2 /GS- /MD"))
    assert d == {"lang": "c", "cl": "21022", "flags": "/O2 /GS- /MD", "lib": "zlib-1.2.3 sub/x.c"}, d


def test_draft_helpers():
    from roc.draft import reconstruction_outline
    outline = reconstruction_outline(["ret 0x10"])
    assert "callee pops 4 stack arg(s)" in outline and "cdecl" not in outline
    assert extract_code("text\n```cpp\nint f();\n```\nmore") == "int f();\n"
    assert extract_code("no code") is None
    assert extract_code("Here is the answer:\nint f() { return 1; }\n") == "int f() { return 1; }\n"
    assert "struct S" in extract_code("struct S { int f(); };\nint S::f() { return 1; }\n")
    plain = ('extern "C" long __cdecl _InterlockedExchangeAdd(volatile long*, long);\n'
             '#pragma intrinsic(_InterlockedExchangeAdd)\n'
             'struct Inner { long count; };\nstruct S { Inner* p; int f(); };\n'
             'int S::f() { return _InterlockedExchangeAdd(&p->count, -1); }\n')
    assert extract_code("Generated source:\n" + plain) == plain
    elf = mini_elf(b"\xc3", 0x401234)
    assert elf[:4] == b"\x7fELF" and elf[0x1000 + 0x234] == 0xC3
    facts = draft.facts_from_asm(["mov eax, dword ptr [ecx + 0x34]", "call dword ptr [sym]", "ret 8"])
    assert facts["calls"] == 1 and facts["this_offsets"] == ["0x34"] and facts["returns"] == ["ret 8"]
    assert draft.model_profile("qwen2.5-coder:7b") == {"num_ctx": 6144, "num_predict": 1536}
    assert draft.model_profile("custom") == {"num_ctx": 8192, "num_predict": 2048}
    assert draft.model_rounds("qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct", 9) == 3
    assert draft.select_generation_strategy("auto", "deepseek:deepseek-flash", {"size": 32}) == "direct"
    assert draft.select_generation_strategy("auto", "deepseek:deepseek-flash", {"size": 33}) == "direct"
    assert draft.select_generation_strategy("auto", "qwen2.5-coder:7b", {"size": 16}) == "direct"
    assert draft.classify_target(["mov eax, dword ptr [ecx + 0x4]", "ret "]) == "leaf/getter"
    assert draft.classify_target(["call sym", "ret "]) == "wrapper/thunk"
    assert "struct Namespace::Type" in draft.RULES
    outline = draft.reconstruction_outline(["mov eax, dword ptr [ecx + 4]", "jne sym", "ret 8"])
    assert "ECX dereferenced" in outline and "callee pops 2" in outline and "jne sym" in outline
    outlined = draft.reconstruction_outline(["00401000  8b4104               mov eax, dword ptr [ecx + 4]",
                                              "00401003  7502                 jne 0x401007", "00401005  c20800               ret 8"])
    assert "branches: jne 0x401007" in outlined
    cfg = draft.cfg_outline(["00401000  7502                 jne 0x401004", "00401002  c3                   ret ",
                             "00401004  ebfa                 jmp 0x401000"])
    assert "B0@00401000:B2/B1" in cfg and "loops=B2->B0" in cfg
    graph = draft.cfg_facts(["00401000  7502                 jne 0x401004", "00401002  c3                   ret ",
                            "00401004  ebfa                 jmp 0x401000"])
    assert graph["reachable"] == [0, 1, 2] and graph["loop_headers"] == [0]
    assert graph["dominators"]["2"] == [0, 2]
    assert draft.semantic_facts(["mov eax, 4", "add eax, 8", "xor ecx, ecx"]) == [
        "eax=4", "eax=(4 + 8)", "ecx=0"]
    constraints = draft.type_constraints(["jb sym", "ret 8"], {"this_reads": [4], "stack_args": [8],
                                                            "virtual_slots": [3], "returns": ["ret 8"]})
    assert "ECX receiver" in constraints and "unsigned branch" in constraints and "virtual slots 3" in constraints
    ir = draft.structure_ir(["00401000  8b4104               mov eax, dword ptr [ecx + 4]",
                             "00401003  7202                 jb 0x401007", "00401005  c20800               ret 8"], facts)
    assert ir["branches"][0]["unsigned"] and ir["receiver_offsets"] == ["0x34"]
    assert ir["signature"]["receiver"] and ir["signature"]["return_instruction"] == "ret 8"
    assert draft.source_contract_error("struct S { int x; };") == "missing function definition"
    assert not draft.source_contract_error("int f(){ return 0; }")
    assert "pseudo-instruction" in draft.source_contract_error("int f(){ push(1); return 0; }")
    sprawl = "struct S {\n" + "\n".join("int field_%d;" % i for i in range(20)) + "\n};\nint f(){return 0;}"
    assert "numbered-field" in draft.source_contract_error(sprawl)
    assert draft.compile_failure_class("error C2227") == "receiver/object pointer misuse"


def test_opcode_family_grouping():
    from roc import fingerprint
    asm = ["00401000  8b01                 mov eax, [ecx]",
           "00401002  c3                   ret"]
    assert fingerprint.opcode_shape(asm) == ("mov", "ret")
    rows = [{"addr": "00401000", "size": 3}, {"addr": "00401010", "size": 3},
            {"addr": "00401020", "size": 5}]
    reps = fingerprint.representatives(rows, lambda row: asm if row["size"] == 3 else ["ret"])
    assert len(reps) == 1 and reps[0][2][0]["addr"] == "00401000"
    assert fingerprint.fingerprint(rows[0], asm) == fingerprint.fingerprint(rows[1], asm)
    assert fingerprint.fingerprint(rows[0], ["ret"]) != fingerprint.fingerprint(rows[0], asm)

def test_draft_stops_at_code_fence(monkeypatch):
    from roc import draft
    class Stream:
        def __init__(self):
            self.rows = iter([b'{"response":"```cpp\\nint f(){}\\n```"}\n',
                              b'{"response":"ignored"}\n'])
        def __enter__(self): return self
        def __exit__(self, *_): return None
        def __iter__(self): return self

def test_budget_refunds_token_overestimate():
    from roc import providers
    budget = providers.CloudBudget(requests=5, tokens=20000)
    ticket = budget.reserve(16000)  # reserve books input estimate + max_tokens
    budget.settle(ticket, 3000)      # measured usage was much smaller
    assert budget.tokens == 3000
    ticket = budget.reserve(16000)   # overestimate refunded: budget still usable
    assert budget.tokens == 19000

        try:

def test_opencode_cli_provider():
    """OpenCode models run through the signed-in CLI: no key, plan allowances."""
    from roc import providers
    old_which, old_run = providers.shutil.which, providers._opencode_run
    try:
        providers.shutil.which = lambda name: "C:\\npm\\opencode.cmd" if name == "opencode" else None
        provider, remote, config = providers.parse_model("opencode:opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash#high")
        assert provider == "opencode" and remote == "opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash#high"
        assert config["kind"] == "opencode-cli" and providers.provider_ready("opencode")
        assert "opencode auth login" in providers.credential_hint("opencode:opencode/x")
        runs = []

        def fake_run(argv, prompt, timeout):
            runs.append((argv, Path(argv[argv.index("--file") + 1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
            return 0, json.dumps({"type": "text", "part": {"text": "```cpp\nint f(){}\n```"}}) + "\n"

        providers._opencode_run = fake_run
        out = providers.generate("opencode:opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash#high", "write cpp",
                                 options={"allow_cloud": True, "max_tokens": 8})
        assert out.provider == "opencode" and out.model == "opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash#high"
        assert "int f(){}" in out.text
        assert runs[0][0][0].endswith("opencode.cmd")
        assert runs[0][0][1:6] == ["run", "-m", "opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash#high", "--format", "json"]
        assert "--file" in runs[0][0] and runs[0][0][-1].startswith("Follow the attached task exactly")
        assert "write cpp" in runs[0][1] and "Reconstruct compact valid C++" in runs[0][1]
        try:
            providers.generate("opencode:opencode/x", "p", options={})
            raise AssertionError("cloud request was not blocked")
        except providers.ProviderError as error:
            assert error.category == "cloud_disabled"
        for error_body, category in (
                ({"type": "provider.quota", "message": "Insufficient account funds", "status": 402}, "provider_auth"),
                ({"type": "provider.no-route", "message": "Variant unavailable for opencode/glm-5.3-flash: bogus"},
                 "provider_error"),
                ({"type": "provider.quota", "message": "Rate limit exceeded.", "status": 429}, "provider_retry")):
            providers._opencode_run = lambda *args, error_body=error_body: (
                1, json.dumps({"type": "error", "error": error_body}) + "\n")
            try:
                providers.generate("opencode:opencode/x", "p", options={"allow_cloud": True, "retries": 0})
                raise AssertionError("run error was not raised")
            except providers.ProviderError as error:
                assert error.category == category and error_body["message"] in str(error)
        try:
            providers.generate("opencode:opencode/x", "p",
                              options={"allow_cloud": True, "budget": providers.CloudBudget(cost=1)})
            raise AssertionError("USD cap was accepted for a plan-allowance provider")
        except providers.ProviderError as error:
            assert error.category == "cloud_budget"
    finally:
        providers.shutil.which = old_which
        providers._opencode_run = old_run

def test_opencode_run_kills_the_tree_on_timeout():
    from roc import providers

    kills = []

    try:

def test_announce_once():
    import threading
    from roc import worker
    worker._ANNOUNCED.clear()
    logged = []
    lock = threading.Lock()
    def log(message):
        with lock:
            logged.append(message)
    threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker.announce_once, args=(("k", "v"), log, "hello"))
               for _ in range(8)]
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join()
    assert logged == ["hello"]
    worker.announce_once(("other",), log, "world")
    assert logged == ["hello", "world"]
    worker._ANNOUNCED.clear()

def test_mine_digest():
    import time
    from roc.reports import MineLog, fmt_duration
    from roc.server import Store
    assert fmt_duration(45) == "45s" and fmt_duration(300) == "5m"
    assert fmt_duration(5400) == "1h 30m" and fmt_duration(90000) == "25h 0m"
    assert fmt_duration(200000) == "2d 7h"
    st = Store(":memory:", lease_seconds=1)
    st.db.executemany("INSERT INTO funcs(client,addr,size,unit,score) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",
                      [("C", "a1", 9, "U1", 100), ("C", "a2", 9, "U2", 50), ("C", "a3", 9, "U3", 0)])
    now = time.time()
    st.db.executemany("INSERT INTO events(ts,client,addr,user,old,new) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                      [(now - 3600, "C", "a1", "alice", 90, 100),
                       (now - 1800, "C", "a2", "alice", 0, 50)])
    st.db.commit()
    assert st.user_points("alice") == 60 and st.user_points("nobody") == 0
    assert st.client_progress("C") == (1, 3)
    assert st.client_bytes("C") == (9, 27)
    assert st.display_progress("C") == (1, 3, 9, 27)
    assert st.match_rate("C") > 0 and st.match_rate("other") == 0
    sent = []
    log = MineLog("http://example.invalid/hook", st, batch_events=10, batch_seconds=60)
    with patch("roc.reports._post", side_effect=lambda url, payload: sent.append(payload)):
        log.submit({"client": "C", "addr": "a1", "unit": "U1", "size": 9}, "alice", "w", "m", 100, 10)
        log.submit({"client": "C", "addr": "a2", "unit": "U2", "size": 9}, "alice", "w", "m", 50, 50)
        assert sent == []  # batched, not spammed
        log.flush()
        assert len(sent) == 1
    embed = sent[0]["embeds"][0]
    assert embed["title"] == "⛏️ RoConstruct Mining Digest"
    assert "33.33%" in embed["description"] and "1 / 3 matched" in embed["description"]

    assert "worker in batch" not in embed["fields"][3]["value"]

    events = [{"job": {"client": "C", "addr": "a1"}, "user": "alice", "worker": "w", "model": "roc fingerprint",
               "score": 100, "points": 10}]
    server_embed = MineLog("http://example.invalid/server", st, server=True).digest(events)
    assert server_embed["title"] == "⛏️ RoConstruct Mining Digest"
    assert server_embed["fields"][3]["name"] == "🏆 Workers"
    assert "alice" in str(server_embed)
    assert server_embed["fields"][-1]["name"] == "🔧 Models"

        thread = threading.Thread(target=httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True)

                 patch("roc.server.check_many_text", side_effect=[[("00401000", 70, [])], [("00401000", 80, [])]]), \
